questions.prompt: Nintendo's Black Friday sale is officially live — the doors are open, the deals are out, and the hunt is on tonight. Which scene sounds most like yours tonight?

options.text: Locked in, list in hand — I've been waiting for this drop.
Browsing slow — if something calls to me, great, if not, no rush.
Drowning in tabs — too many deals, I can't pick one.
Already know what I want — in, out, done, no fuss.

questions.prompt: GTA 6's guides are out — and the BF Bandito is sitting there in Vice City, waiting to be stolen. The heist is right in front of you tonight. How are you meeting it?

options.text: Going for it — engine running, no more planning.
Casing it first — one clean run, no mistakes.
Bringing the crew — a steal this good needs witnesses.
Letting it roll past — the city's full of rides, no rush.

questions.prompt: Guadagnino's American Psycho isn't happening — he said so himself. The thing you were waiting for just... isn't coming. Tonight, how are you sitting with that?

options.text: Honestly relieved — some stories are better left exactly as they are.
Annoyed — I was ready for it, and now there's nothing to wait for.
Moving on — already lining up the next thing to look forward to.
Quietly shelving it — a little disappointed, and not in the mood to talk about it.

questions.prompt: The Hunger Games debate is on tonight — five dystopian shows that might just top it, and the marathon's already started. If someone handled the table for your watch-party, what would you want on it?

options.text: A full arena feast — big spread, everyone digging in.
Something warm and simple — comfort food for a heavy night.
Snacks to pass around — something for every ranking debate.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Taylor Swift left Megan Moroney a handwritten note at the CMAs — a small quiet gesture in the middle of music's loudest night. Tonight, what kind of note are you in the mood for?

options.text: A long one to someone who needs it — the real words, on paper.
A quick funny one to the group chat — keep the night light.
A quiet one, just for one person — no audience needed.
No note tonight — keeping the evening to myself.

questions.prompt: GTA VI made nearly $4 billion on day one — the biggest launch in entertainment history, and tonight's the afterglow. In the hour ahead, what does your evening feel like?

options.text: Straight back in — a night this big doesn't end early.
Easing off — letting the record sink in, nice and slow.
Calling a friend — did you see the number?
Still buzzing — too many good ways to spend the hour.
